$comment: Client-bundle budgets, enforced by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs (--check) after `next build` in CI. Values are KB gzip and include the shared rootMainFiles baseline. Re-measured at v1.33.0: / 429, /insights 414, /measurements 416, /insights/mood 432, total 3060, baseline 130. The aggregate rose 78 KB from v1.32.0's 2982 because that release adds surfaces rather than libraries: a dose-history import card, inventory date editing, fourteen confirmation dialogs, and a job-failure panel. Every per-route cap still passes with headroom, and the thing this aggregate exists to catch (a newly duplicated ~90 KB library) did not happen: the Recharts chunk count is still 1 and structurally guarded. Raised 3050 to 3120 for that reason, not to make a red check green. Route caps retain focused headroom. Message catalogs and duplicate Recharts chunks have dedicated structural guards.
